column1: # tests/memfn/c12_ceilings.tsv -- C12, THE EMITTED-FORM RATCHET's CEILINGS
# (integration.md §9.3 I5, §10.5, §R4.3.4; born at R4c, lane r4cchecks,
# 2026-10-06, from TODAY'S tree on lane/memfn-r4c).
# C12 counts, per (emitter file, vocabulary line, libc call name), the search
# FORMS that file's emitters SPELL in emitted text (string literals; the
# emitter's own comments excluded; tests/memfn/search_vocab.tsv names the
# shapes, tests/memfn/c17_lex.py reads the literals). Each row is a CEILING
# that only DESCENDS:
#   - more forms than the ceiling is red: a replaced form came back as a
#     second spelling (D122), or a new one was spelled outside the kit;
#   - FEWER than the ceiling is red too ("lower the ceiling"): a migration
#     step's REPLACE commit lowers its rows in the same commit, and a stale
#     high ceiling would be room for a form to return unseen. It also makes a
#     lexer or vocabulary that stopped seeing forms red, never green;
#   - a form with NO row here has ceiling 0.
# The number on a row is the ONE literal a REPLACE commit edits: M1's REPLACE
# lowered the emit_dfa.c memchr row 8 -> 2 (R4c, lane r4cfix: pcrec_emit_find
# and emit_attempt stay until M2/M4; the six M1 spellings are the kit's).
# A RAISE is never routine: it needs a ruling, named in the commit.
# The row count (12) and the total (20 forms; 26 before M1) are echoed by the check; the
# independent control is the vocabulary's own reach (rule 4 of C17).
# Columns (tab-separated): path, vocab line-id, libc call name (libc-call
# lines only, else -), ceiling, note.
